definitions.gloss: prison break; jailbreak; escape from prison
definitions.explanation: The act of escaping from a prison or jail. Used in news reports, crime fiction, and historical accounts.

examples.japanese: {囚人|しゅうじん}が{脱獄|だつごく}した。
{脱獄|だつごく}{犯|はん}はまだ{捕|つか}まっていない。
examples.english: The escaped prisoner has not been caught yet.

examples.japanese: その{映画|えいが}は{実際|じっさい}にあった{脱獄|だつごく}{事件|じけん}を{基|もと}にしている。
examples.english: The movie is based on a real prison break incident.

notes:
{脱獄|だつごく} means escaping from prison. Composed of {脱|だつ} (escape) + {獄|ごく} (prison).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脱獄|だつごく}する: to break out of prison
- {脱獄|だつごく}{犯|はん}: escaped prisoner
- {脱獄|だつごく}{事件|じけん}: prison break incident
- {脱獄|だつごく}を{企|くわだ}てる: to plan a prison break
- {脱獄|だつごく}を{図|はか}る: to attempt a prison escape
- {脱獄|だつごく}{未遂|みすい}: attempted jailbreak

MODERN USAGE:
Also used informally in computing to mean "jailbreaking" a device (removing software restrictions on a phone or tablet).

RELATED:
- {脱走|だっそう}: escape, desertion (broader — from military, institution, etc.)
- {逃亡|とうぼう}: flight, running away (after escaping)
- {投獄|とうごく}: imprisonment (opposite — putting someone in prison)
